<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/plugins/registry"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches the index of every registry that is on (each cached for 15 minutes unless refresh is set), with each one's status under registries, and merges them with what is installed here: the installed version, the newest release this build can run, whether an update asks for new capabilities, and the pin and auto-update choices.
